reference_sql:
WITH one_variant AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(variant) AS variant, MIN(assigned_at) AS assigned_at
  FROM ab_assignments
  WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01'
  GROUP BY customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(*) = 1
)
SELECT o.variant, COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id) AS n_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n_converted,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct,
  ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.revenue_eur), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer_eur
FROM one_variant o
LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = 'AB-2025-01' AND c.customer_id = o.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= o.assigned_at
GROUP BY o.variant
ORDER BY o.variant
alternatives: SELECT a.variant, COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id) AS n_customers, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n_converted, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.revenue_eur), 0) / COUNT(DISTINCT a.customer_id), 2) AS revenue_per_customer_eur FROM ab_assignments a LEFT JOIN ab_assignments other ON other.test_id = a.test_id AND other.customer_id = a.customer_id AND other.variant <> a.variant LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01' AND other.customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY a.variant ORDER BY a.variant

WITH both_variants AS (SELECT customer_id FROM ab_assignments WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant) > 1), per_customer AS (SELECT a.variant, a.customer_id, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS n_conv, SUM(c.revenue_eur) AS revenue FROM ab_assignments a LEFT JOIN both_variants b ON b.customer_id = a.customer_id LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = a.test_id AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at WHERE a.test_id = 'AB-2025-01' AND b.customer_id IS NULL GROUP BY a.variant, a.customer_id) SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS n_customers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_conv > 0) AS n_converted, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_conv > 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct, ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(revenue, 0)) / COUNT(*), 2) AS revenue_per_customer_eur FROM per_customer GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant

solver.query:
WITH a AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(variant) AS variant, MIN(assigned_at) AS assigned_at FROM ab_assignments WHERE test_id = 'AB-2025-01' GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT variant) = 1),
per AS (SELECT a.customer_id, a.variant, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS n_conv, COALESCE(SUM(c.revenue_eur), 0) AS rev FROM a LEFT JOIN ab_conversions c ON c.test_id = 'AB-2025-01' AND c.customer_id = a.customer_id AND c.converted_at >= a.assigned_at GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.variant)
SELECT variant, COUNT(*) AS n_customers, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_conv > 0) AS n_converted,
ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_conv > 0) / COUNT(*), 2) AS conversion_rate_pct,
ROUND(CAST(SUM(rev) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*), 2) AS revenue_per_customer_eur
FROM per GROUP BY variant ORDER BY variant
